sources.limit: No local replication; no permission to add a spot/option/other-venue leg and no standalone directional-alpha conclusion.

sources.limit: Cross-correlation evidence alone does not specify a stable executable spread or contemporary hourly cost-after directional rule.

cards.distinctness: Two perpetual legs could express relative value rather than a funding-sign or single-asset entry filter.
cards.available_data: Synchronized admitted BTC/ETH OHLCV, marks and exact funding are available.
cards.missing_evidence: No frozen economic anchor, hedge rule or supported convergence horizon identified by this bounded primary-source review. Contemporary stability and net edge remain UNKNOWN; neither was measured.
cards.not_selected_reason: Correlation does not supply the missing convergence mechanism; fitting a convenient mean-reverting spread now would add result-sensitive modeling choices without the required mechanism evidence.
cards.reopen_condition: New primary-source mechanism with a preregisterable hedge and time scale, followed by separate legal development admission; do not substitute a forum z-score recipe.

cards.distinctness: Relative pricing against an index is economically different from funding-level/change directional controls.
cards.available_data: Raw first-capture index/premium records exist, but are absent from the currently admitted development manifest.
cards.missing_evidence: An index reference is not an executable hedge leg; no permitted spot, option or second-venue leg was introduced. Perpetual-only price returns do not isolate convergence of the basis.
cards.not_selected_reason: Cannot faithfully claim basis-arbitrage evidence using one unhedged directional leg or ignore admission and execution costs.
cards.reopen_condition: A mechanism expressible solely with permitted BTC/ETH USDT perpetual legs, with explicitly admitted inputs and complete execution/cost provenance.

cards.distinctness: Calendar-conditioned market activity is different information from settled funding direction.
cards.available_data: Hourly timestamps and OHLCV can express coarse calendar activity; subhour/order-book execution is unavailable.
cards.missing_evidence: Primary source supports volume/volatility seasonality, not a signed-return premium or standalone entry rule.
cards.not_selected_reason: A risk-timing observation is not a new profitable strategy. Adding hour gates to failed flow/breakout/funding branches would reopen their result-dependent optimization.
cards.reopen_condition: A separately supported directional or executable risk-premium mechanism, rather than selection of a favorable hour after viewing returns.
